text: Over the last 25 hours, BAM share rose 1.16 percentage points to 37.8%, extending a 0.79 percentage-point gain over 7 days. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 22.2% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 4. The top node by stake changed hands 68 times in this window, consistent with whale-driven routing rather than a structural rollover; recent precursor signals in ams and tyo remain worth watching.
